# test_llm_tool_tool

> Test execute a custom LLM Tool with provided parameters.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `llm_tools` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=test_llm_tool_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Test execute a custom LLM Tool with provided parameters.

Executes the tool's JavaScript call_block code without invoking through an agent.
Useful for debugging and validating tools before assigning them to agents.
Returns the result or any errors.

EXAMPLES:
Test by ID: {id: 123, params: {value: 42}}
Test by name: {name: "my_tool", params: {query: "test"}}
Test with no params: {name: "simple_tool", params: {}}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | no | Tool ID (use id OR name) |
| `name` | string | no | Tool name (use id OR name) |
| `params` | object | no | Test parameters to pass to the tool. |
